subject: Clarifying scope: admin activity streaming vs snapshot exports for SOC2 evidence
messages:
From: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@acmehealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: audits@acmehealth.com, security@acmehealth.com
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Admin activity evidence format question

Hi Hannah —

Thanks for the quick onboarding call yesterday. As part of our SOC 2 readiness review we need a clear description of what admin activity you can provide and how — specifically:

- Can you provide a continuous export (changefeed/stream) of admin events, or only periodic snapshot bundles?
- For exports, what is the canonical schema (timestamps, event_type, actor_id, target_id, ip, region, request_id)?
- How do you handle timezone normalization & daylight savings across regions: UTC only?
- Retention: what historical window can we request in an export (30/90/365 days) and how are deleted records represented?

We tried a sample CSV you shared but the header names differ from what our auditors expect. Please advise next steps and whether you can produce an export that matches our internal evidence template.

Appreciate it —
Maria
Security & Compliance, Acme Health
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Admin activity evidence format question

Hi Maria —

Thanks for the concrete list — that helps. Short answers up front:

- We support both approaches: a streaming changefeed (preferred for continuous monitoring) and snapshot bundles (for point-in-time evidence packages).
- Canonical schema we publish is attached as export-schema.md; core fields: utc_timestamp, event_type, actor_email_hash, actor_id, target_type, target_id, verb, request_id, ip_address (anonymized by default), region, user_agent, session_id, kv_delta (JSON string).
- All timestamps are normalized to UTC. We include an iso8601 string and epoch millis.
- Retention: hosted customers have 90 days by default; we can provide up to 365 days for enterprise plans and dedicated/private deployments. Deleted records are captured as tombstone events (event_type: OBJECT_DELETED) with a deletion_reason when available.

Two important notes:
1) For streaming exports we provide a signed, incremental change token so you can resume from any point without re-downloading the whole stream.
2) For CSV snapshots we include a manifest file with checksum and a redaction map for any fields we obfuscate.

I attached the canonical schema and a small sample CSV from a 24-hour window. Let us know which auditor template you need us to map to and we can produce a one-off, column-mapped bundle for delivery.

Best,
Hannah
Senior Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: export-schema.md (text), admin_activity_sample.csv (csv)
From: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@acmehealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: audits@acmehealth.com, security@acmehealth.com
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Admin activity evidence format question

Hannah —

This is great, thanks. A couple follow-ups from our audit team after they reviewed the sample:

- They want to confirm whether the actor identifiers can be pseudonymized (hash + salt) but still allow us to resolve them via a redaction key exchange for legal review.
- For streaming exports, our auditors prefer delivery to an S3 bucket in our account. Can Redwood push to an external bucket with server-side encryption and bucket-level policy controls?
- We need guidance on sampling policy: if you do sampling for retention optimization (e.g., partial event retention under 365-day plan), can you guarantee that any events relevant to role changes, privilege escalations, or policy edits are never sampled out?

If you can confirm these three items we can update our SOC 2 matrix and move to scheduling a transfer test.

Thanks,
Maria
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 15:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Admin activity evidence format question

Maria —

Answers below; I summarized next steps at the bottom.

1) Pseudonymization & key exchange:
- We can provide actor identifiers as salted SHA-256 hashes by default. For legal or forensics use, we support a secure key exchange process (we will create a time-limited decryption token tied to a specific export manifest and a signed request from an authorized Acme Health admin). That token allows our secure backfill service to return resolved identifiers for events in that export only — there is an auditable access log.

2) Delivery to customer S3:
- Yes. We support push delivery to customer-owned S3 buckets in AWS and GCS buckets. Requirements:
  * Bucket must provide server-side encryption (SSE-KMS preferred)
  * We will upload to a designated prefix and provide a manifest (SHA256 checksums + file sizes).
  * We support cross-account IAM role assumption (you create a role we can assume) or pre-signed put URLs.

3) Sampling policy & fidelity guarantees:
- By default we do no sampling for admin-activity events for customers with compliance needs within the retention window. For customers on cost-optimized retention we may tier older, low-signal events to compressed archives; however, high-sensitivity event types (role_change, permission_grant, permission_revoke, admin_login_failed, policy_override) are always preserved at full fidelity for the entire retention period.

Next steps we propose:
- Action 1: You send the auditor CSV template (column names + required formats).
- Action 2: We'll run a small transfer test: 48-hour changefeed exported to your S3 test prefix using the cross-account role.
- Action 3: If mapping is required, we'll produce a mapped snapshot that fits your auditor template and a signed manifest.

Ben and Kim, can you own the transfer test coordination? Ben — can you share the IAM role instructions and temporary policy we recommend. Kim — can you own mapping and checksum verification once the transfer completes.

Thanks — Maria, if that plan looks good I can schedule the test early next week.

Regards,
Hannah

On behalf of Redwood Inference
